correctness.rationale: Exact graph and quantifiers are fixed. The unoriented incidence identity gives F=B^TB, connectivity gives rank F=2^d-2, and BB^T multiplies by q=e_2+...+e_d in a square-zero group algebra. A constructive degree-by-degree coordinate-normalization lemma applies because the e2 alternating form has corank at most one. The resulting tensor-sum differential has rank 2^(d-1)-2^floor((d-1)/2); the socle containment yields rank F^2 smaller by two, while q^2=0 forces F^3=0. Jordan block equations and kernel sizes give all exact counts. Independently constructed line-graph matrices and exhaustive d=3 dynamics match the closed theorem; finite tests are corroborative only.
